test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The solution is **bedrock**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4 is bedrock.
 
• Similarly, mathematics, the bedrock of science, gives meaning to the concept of quantification and (5)_________ value for us humans.
 
• **Bedrock - **The fundamental principles on which something is based.
 
 
• **​***For example : "Honestly is the bedrock of a good relationship."*
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:

 
 
• **​Glory - **High renown or honour won by notable achievements.

 
 
• ​*For example : "To fight and die for the glory of one's nation."*
 
 
 
• **Secret - **Not known or seen or not meant to be known or seen by others.
 
 
• ​*For example : "They kept their relationship secret,"*
 
 
 
• **Crest - **A comb or tuft of feathers, fur, or skin on the head of a bird or other animal.
 
 
• ​*For example : "A large game bird with a conspicuous erect red crest."*
